basic_info.description: Set in an 1897 Queen Anne building across from the Eureka Valley Rec Center, this freshly updated 2-bedroom condo blends historic charm with smart, modern touches. Think coved ceilings, picture rails, and detailed millwork alongside hand-picked upgrades like LED lighting on dimmers, in-unit laundry, and large deeded parking in a detached carriage house.    The functional layout features two full-sized bedrooms  one with an oak-mantled decorative fireplace, the other accented by a wallpaper feature wall  plus a recently redone bath with a soaking tub, vintage-style fittings, and deep navy walls that bring out a serene, spa-like feel.    The updated kitchen balances crisp design and utility with quartz counters, matte hardware, floating lit shelves, tile backsplash, designer lighting, gas cooking, and a dishwasher, while your laundry machines are neatly tucked in. A dining area under a new enameled pendant opens directly to a leafy deeded rear deck, perfect for coffee, dinner, or catching the breeze.    With deeded carriage-house parking, a 98 Walk Score, and a location seconds from Mollie Stone's, the dog park, post office, MUNI, Dolores Park, and Kite Hill, this home is as convenient as it is charming  quiet, connected, and right in the flow of Castro energy.
